scripts.build-schema: pnpm build-testing-schema && pnpm build-ui-schema && pnpm build-backend-schema
scripts.build-ui-schema: rm -rf ui/src/Types/API/ && json2ts --cwd schema/ -i schema/ -o ui/src/Types/API/
scripts.build-backend-schema: rm -rf backend/src/types/API/ && json2ts --cwd schema/ -i schema/ -o backend/src/types/API/
scripts.build-testing-schema: rm -rf testing/cypress/e2e/api/schema && cp -r schema/ testing/cypress/e2e/api/ && find testing/cypress/e2e/api/schema/ -maxdepth 1 -type f -exec mv \{\} \{\}.json \;
